opening.argument: Judge, the exchange pitch links a reward directly to viewer action. The speaker says trading bonuses and coupons are available as viewers trade, then tells them to check the exchange through the description links. That is more than a passing mention of an exchange: the stated benefit depends on participation. The description reinforces the route with a separate invitation to get a free trading bonus. The case for treating this as a solicitation rests on that promise-action pairing, even though the video also contains market analysis.

Charts and uncertainty about price do not resolve whether the linked trading incentive is a solicitation. Nor does a disclaimer explain the bonus terms or change the action the speaker requests.
